name: Confirm this person lives here (owner attestation)
hostSurface: Opened from the members roster (owner/admin) and from a notification triggered when a household member starts verification on an already-claimed home.
purpose: Give a co-resident a completable path to address verification on a home someone else has already claimed.
contents: The person, when they joined, what confirming grants them (neighbor messages, residency letter, Block Founder rank), the owner's attestation checkbox with its plain consequence line, Confirm / Decline. Writes verification_source='address'.
states: owner has revoked the member's access
entryPoints: Verify sheet's 'Ask {owner} to confirm you live here' path
visualization: A short attestation sheet: one person, one statement, one checkbox, two buttons. It reads as a vouching act, not a permissions grid.
uxNote: Adversarial blocker. F3b's whole 'never hide, always explain, always offer the path' promise collapses if postcard, document and landlord flows all require the owner — every locked control would lead to a sheet nobody can complete, which is worse than hiding the control. Confirm which methods accept a non-owner occupant before the migration; if none do, this sheet is a hard prerequisite for F3b.
